newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise sees Manila sales $200 mln/year.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise sees Manila sales $200 mln/year.

text.p: French utilities company Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Thursday that a Philippine joint venture company it was setting up to manage a 25-year water contract in Manila will have average annual turnover of $200 million for the first 10 years.
Lyonnaise and its local partner Benpres Holdings Corp were on Thursday awarded one of the two 25-year contracts in the privatisation of the Manila waterworks.

Lyonnaise said in a statement it will hold 40 percent and Benpres 60 percent of the new company, which will be the operator under the contract and which is expected to invest between $2.4 and $4.0 billion over the contract period.
The operator will provide clean water and water treatment services for Manila's western zone and will be the auspices of the Philippine government's Metropolitan Water and Sewage System.
